questions.question: Does `npx tsc --noEmit` (or `make build`) complete with zero errors and zero warnings after all S1-S4 changes are applied? Provide the full compiler output (which must be empty on success). If any error appears, name the file and line so the owning story can be reopened.

After all epic changes compile cleanly, does the TypeScript compiler confirm that no switch statement in any production file has an unhandled discriminant arm caused by the removal of `task.snapshot` from the union? The absence of errors from `npx tsc --noEmit` is the evidence — confirm the output is clean and that no `@ts-ignore` was added to suppress exhaustiveness errors in any file under `src/`.

Could the `task-reducer` module (which owns S5 per stories.json) be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its declared dependencies? S5 introduces no code changes — confirm this by showing that the S5 scope contains only command invocations and no file edits, and that all cross-module contracts established by S1-S4 flow through the declared seam in `persistence.ts`.

Does `make test` pass all surviving tests (i.e. tests not deliberately deleted by AC-TEST-1 through AC-TEST-8) with zero new failures after all epic changes? Provide the `make test` output summary showing total passing count and zero failures. Confirm that the deleted test count matches the expected deletions: one describe block in `task-reducer.test.ts`, the D3 block and snapshot guards in `multi-client.property.test.ts`, and the D3 block plus the snapshot pass-through in `task-reducer.property.test.ts`.

After all changes compile and tests pass, does `grep -rn 'task\.snapshot\|TASK_SNAPSHOT_KIND\|SNAPSHOT_D_TAG\|publishTaskSnapshot\|fetchTaskSnapshot\|sign_event:30078' src/` return zero matches across all production files? Provide the empty output as the final confirmation that no snapshot artifact survives in the production codebase.

Does `make build` (or `npx tsc --noEmit`) succeed with zero new TypeScript errors after all S1-S4 changes? Confirm specifically: (a) no unhandled discriminant arm errors remain from the union shrink, (b) no unresolved reference to any deleted symbol (`publishTaskSnapshot`, `fetchTaskSnapshot`, `TASK_SNAPSHOT_KIND`, `SNAPSHOT_D_TAG`) remains in any file, and (c) `src/types/notestr-test-hooks.d.ts` still imports `TaskEvent` validly without modification. Show the compiler output.

Does `make test` pass all surviving tests — including `src/lib/nostr.test.ts` lines 137-159 (the NIP46_PERMS locality test, validating AC-WIRE-4) — with zero failures? Provide the full `make test` output. Confirm that `nostr.test.ts` was not modified to make it pass, by showing `git diff src/lib/nostr.test.ts` is empty after all epic changes are applied.
